title: Final Electric Field E_x
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for E_x must be correctly stated as E_x = q/chi * gamma * (x - vt).

title: Final Magnetic Field B_x
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for B_x must be correctly stated as B_x = 0.

title: Final Electric Field E_y
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for E_y must be correctly stated as E_y = q/chi * gamma * y.

title: Final Magnetic Field B_y
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for B_y must be correctly stated as B_y = -q/chi * beta * gamma * z.

title: Final Electric Field E_z
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for E_z must be correctly stated as E_z = q/chi * gamma * z.

title: Final Magnetic Field B_z
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for B_z must be correctly stated as B_z = q/chi * beta * gamma * y.

title: Use of Lorentz Transformation
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly apply the Lorentz transformation for coordinates between frames.

title: Correct Use of gamma and beta
description: Important Criteria - The definitions of gamma and beta must be correctly used in the context of the problem.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for common sign mistakes in the expressions for B_y and B_z.
